# Fitmap Project Instructions

## Project Overview
React Native Expo app for connecting users with gyms. Supports both users and gym service providers.

## Key Features
- User and service provider modes
- Main screen with gym slider and category browsing (Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze)
- User registration and authentication
- Side menu navigation (User Info, Settings)
- Category-based gym listings
- Blue theme matching the gym logo

## Development Guidelines
- Use React Native Expo SDK
- React Navigation for routing (stack navigation)
- Pure JavaScript (no TypeScript)
- Placeholder data until API integration
- Clean, modular component structure
